qualification: Only the selected byte-pinned FEFF10 engineering job verified by native Graph2 discovery. The rule adds no FEFF simulation or scientific eligibility.
extent: The literal suffix of the selected child stream after the complete line which terminated the expanded reader. Every suffix byte is preserved. No token, field or further reference is interpreted.
owner: The document that owns the captured job, with independent resource identity for the actual child stream.
footprint: The complete graph metadata node for this captured job. The node identity uses the actual document-relative pointer and normalization of typed resource IDs to the verified persistent logical resource keys. The rule, graph namespace and complete resource-use closure are fixed across subsequent saves.
closure: complete-no-external-references for the suffix. The active source archive still requires its complete verified Graph2.
failure: An unverified scope, changed footprint, spoofed rule, incomplete or edited raw extent, graph/context change, missing or unexpected block refuses complete-project save.
